title: lnc3.17: Keep with no pools uses wrong outcome type (metric discrepancy)
description:
In session.rs line 919, when Keep action is taken with both mail_pool and pool as None, the code sets nntp_queue_error=true instead of returning SieveOutcome::TransientError. While both send 452, they have different metric tracking:
- TransientError (line 661-672): increments SMTP_MESSAGES_REJECTED_TOTAL with label 'transient'
- Accepted{nntp_queue_error:true} (line 649-651): does not increment rejection metrics

The comment at lines 912-918 explicitly states 'Return a 452 transient failure so the sending MTA retries', suggesting the intent was to return TransientError for consistency with other double-failure cases (lines 880, 884, 897, 901).

Scenario: SMTP config has both delivery.mail_db_path and delivery.queue_dir disabled (unlikely but possible).

Expected: Return SieveOutcome::TransientError for metric consistency.
Actual: Sets nntp_queue_error=true (achieves 452 but with wrong metric labeling).

Impact: Metrics may be misclassified, making it harder to diagnose delivery issues in this edge case.
